scope: Inspect the seven supplied reference images through authorized access; record honest type/era/scale limits without publicly reposting them.

Produce two original concept sheets: (1) a consistent mini-truck base flatbed, one cold-box fit demonstration and base plus two restrained finish treatments; (2) the actual-garage orbit viewer with preview/apply/cancel/reset/zoom-limit direction.
Give the three style families equal value; rear/chase-angle, rear three-quarter, side and front geometry must agree. English UI; blank or separately checked Japanese signage.
Capture the current game cel-anime look as a labeled engine frame and use it as the implementation target. Reconcile existing final-only mock direction instead of generating another conflicting base.
Document cold-box art as conceptual until the module owner supplies real capability. Six looks are future direction only.

visual_brief.skill_workflow: Reference pixels → original labeled 2D contact sheet → independent pixel review. Use current image-generation/design skill; 3dviz-pro-max visual-iteration workflow is the downstream handoff.
visual_brief.quality_bar: Same cab/bed/wheel geometry across all variants, modest work-truck proportions, broad cel-shaded paint zones, legible rear cargo/lamps; garage controls do not obscure the truck.
visual_brief.excluded_shortcuts: No traced logo/mural, no fabricated source-photo label, no generated text treated as final lettering, no box-model or beauty render labeled gameplay.
visual_brief.effort_calibration: Serious reference sorting and visual iteration, bounded to the two sheets; no production 3D.
visual_brief.evidence: Opened source manifest, labeled contact sheets, reviewer notes and hashes.
visual_brief.merge_and_status: Leave draft PR open, author in_review only; no self-acceptance.
visual_brief.standing_constraints: Original/permission-safe outputs only; preserve existing graybox and production owners.
